ja: 私の失言は寛大に見逃された。
en: My slip was graciously overlooked.
alternatives: You kindly let my slip pass.
My tactless remark was kindly excused.
point: graciously は寛大に受け止めた好意を表す。

ja: 遅れてごめんね。
en: Sorry I'm late.
alternatives: I'm sorry I'm late.
Sorry for being late.
point: 謝るときは sorry で始めてよい

ja: もっと気遣えばよかったよ。
en: I wish I'd been more considerate.
alternatives: I wish I'd been more thoughtful.
I should have been more considerate.
If only I'd been more considerate.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: 私が君なら、まだ怒ってるだろうな。
en: In your shoes, I'd still be furious.
alternatives: If I were you, I'd still be furious.
I'd still be angry if I were you.
point: 「私が君なら」は In your shoes / If I were you

ja: お礼に何を渡せるかな？
en: What thank-you gift can I give?
alternatives: What gift could I give you?
What could I offer as thanks?
point: what でお礼に渡せるものを尋ねる。

ja: 思ってた以上に助かったよ。
en: That helped more than I expected.
alternatives: It helped more than I expected.
That was more helpful than I expected.
point: than の後ろは I expected。過去形で言う

ja: 次は遅刻しません。
en: I won't be late again.
alternatives: I'll be on time next time.
I won't be late next time.
point: 約束は will not(won't)

ja: ごめん、今遅れてるよ。
en: Sorry, I'm running late.
alternatives: I'm running late, sorry.
Sorry, I'm running behind.
point: 「遅れてる」は be running late

ja: 君の手間を甘く見てた、ごめん。
en: Sorry, I'd underestimated your efforts.
alternatives: Sorry, I'd taken your efforts too lightly.
I'm sorry I'd undervalued your efforts.
point: underestimate は手間や努力を少なく見積もること。

ja: お待たせしてすみません。
en: Sorry to keep you waiting.
alternatives: I'm sorry to keep you waiting.
I apologize for keeping you waiting.
point: 謝る理由は sorry to + 動詞

ja: お礼のカードがある。
en: There's a thank-you card.
alternatives: I have a thank-you card.
A thank-you card is here.
point: thank-you card は感謝を伝えるカード。

ja: 助けてくれてなきゃ、今困ってる。
en: If you hadn't helped, I'd be lost.
alternatives: I'd be lost now if you hadn't helped.
If you hadn't helped then, I'd be stuck now.
point: 過去の条件と今の結果は had + 過去分詞、would + 原形

ja: 私が感謝するのは君の口の堅さだ。
en: It's your discretion that I appreciate.
alternatives: What I appreciate is your discretion.
It's your confidentiality that I appreciate.
point: discretion は秘密を漏らさない配慮も表す。

ja: 貸してくれた傘、ありがとう。
en: Thanks for the umbrella you lent me.
alternatives: Thanks for lending me your umbrella.
I appreciate the umbrella you lent me.
point: the umbrella (that) you lent me と後ろから説明

ja: 君の助けを受けるよ。
en: I'll accept your help.
alternatives: I'll let you help me.
I'll welcome your help.
point: accept は差し出された助けを受け入れること。

ja: ささやかなお礼です。
en: It's a small thank-you.
alternatives: Here's a little thank-you.
Just a small thank-you.
point: 「お礼」は a thank-you と名詞にできる

ja: 気にしないでね。
en: Don't worry about it.
alternatives: Don't worry.
No worries.
point: 否定の命令文は Don't + 動詞

ja: 君がいなければ、発表は大失敗だった。
en: Without you, the presentation would've been a disaster.
alternatives: Without you, I'd have bombed the presentation.
I'd have bombed the presentation without you.
point: Without ~ は if 節の代わりにもなる

ja: 何かお返しできる？
en: Can I repay you?
alternatives: Can I return the favor?
Can I do something in return?
point: 「お返しする」は repay や return the favor

ja: 君には本当に窮地を救ってもらったよ。
en: You really bailed me out of a jam.
alternatives: You really bailed me out.
You really got me out of a jam.
point: bail out は窮地から救い出す

ja: 忙しいのに来てくれてどうも。
en: Thanks for coming despite being busy.
alternatives: Thanks for coming, even though you're busy.
Thank you for coming despite your busy schedule.
point: despite の後ろは -ing か名詞

ja: ずっとお礼を言いたかった。
en: I've been wanting to thank you.
alternatives: I've always wanted to thank you.
I've been wanting to say thank you.
point: 続いている願望は have been wanting

ja: 私からお詫びしてもいい？
en: May I offer an apology?
alternatives: Can I offer an apology?
May I apologize?
point: offer an apology で丁寧にお詫びを申し出る。

ja: 夕飯おごってもいい？
en: Can I buy you dinner?
alternatives: May I buy you dinner?
Can I treat you to dinner?
point: 「おごる」は buy 人 物 か treat

ja: 君を当然の存在とは決して思わない。
en: Never will I take you for granted.
alternatives: I'll never take you for granted.
I'll always appreciate having you around.
point: take you for granted は君のありがたみを忘れること。

ja: ちゃんとお礼、言ってなかったよね。
en: I never thanked you properly, did I?
alternatives: I never did thank you properly, did I?
I don't think I ever thanked you properly.
point: never + 過去形で「一度もしなかった」。否定文の付加疑問は did I?

ja: 君は親切だね。
en: You're kind.
alternatives: You're so kind.
You're very nice.
point: kind は相手の親切さを褒める。

ja: 電話してれば、待たせなかった。
en: If I'd called, you wouldn't have waited.
alternatives: I wouldn't have kept you waiting if I'd called.
If I'd called, you wouldn't have had to wait.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、wouldn't have + 過去分詞

ja: ここにミスがあるよ。
en: There's a mistake here.
alternatives: There's an error here.
I see a mistake here.
point: 「ミス」は a mistake。a を忘れない

ja: どれだけ嬉しいか言葉にできない。
en: I can't express how happy I am.
alternatives: I can't tell you how happy I am.
I can't say how glad I am.
point: how happy の後ろは平叙文の語順（I am）

ja: お礼の品をもう選びました。
en: I've picked a thank-you gift.
alternatives: I've chosen a thank-you gift.
I've selected a thank-you gift.
point: thank-you を名詞の前に置いてお礼用と伝える。

ja: こまめに連絡すべきでした。
en: I should have kept you posted.
alternatives: I should have updated you more often.
I should have kept you in the loop.
point: 後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 一晩泊めてくれてありがとう。
en: Thanks for letting me stay overnight.
alternatives: Thank you for putting me up.
Thanks for letting me stay the night.
point: 「泊めてくれて」は letting me stay

ja: 気づかず君の善意を利用し続けてる。
en: I've unknowingly been trading on your goodwill.
alternatives: I've been unknowingly taking advantage of your goodwill.
I've been unwittingly exploiting your generosity.
point: trade on は相手の善意などを自分の利益に使う。

ja: 彼は私の判断ミスを見逃すと言った。
en: He said he'd overlook my misjudgment.
alternatives: He said he'd forgive my misjudgment.
He said he'd excuse my error in judgment.
point: misjudgment は判断を誤ったことを指す。

ja: 君が犠牲にしたことを私は詫びる。
en: I'm sorry for what you gave up.
alternatives: I apologize for what you sacrificed.
I'm sorry about the sacrifices you made.
point: what you gave up は相手が犠牲にしたことを表す。

ja: 君のしてくれたことが、沁みたよ。
en: What you did really touched me.
alternatives: I was really touched by what you did.
What you did meant a lot to me.
point: What you did が主語になる名詞節

ja: 彼女に謝ったほうがいいな。
en: I should apologize to her.
alternatives: I'd better apologize to her.
I ought to apologize to her.
point: 「〜に謝る」は apologize to

ja: 私が埋め合わせできれば喜んでするのに。
en: Were I able, I'd gladly make amends.
alternatives: If I could, I'd gladly make amends.
I'd gladly make amends if I were able.
point: Were I able は自分が埋め合わせできるという仮定を倒置で表す。

ja: アドバイスありがとう。
en: Thanks for the advice.
alternatives: Thank you for the advice.
I appreciate the advice.
point: advice は数えられない名詞。a は付けない

ja: 頭が冷えたら私は謝るよ。
en: I'll apologize once I cool off.
alternatives: Once I'm calm, I'll apologize.
I'll apologize after cooling off.
point: cool off は怒りが静まる、once 節は現在形。

ja: お気遣いに感動しました。
en: I was touched by your kindness.
alternatives: Your kindness really touched me.
I was moved by your thoughtfulness.
point: 感動したは be touched(受け身)

ja: 君の厚意にどう報いるか分からない。
en: I don't know how to reciprocate your generosity.
alternatives: I'm unsure how I can repay your kindness.
I don't know how to repay your kindness.
point: reciprocate は受けた厚意に応える。

ja: 君が見逃してくれて感謝してる。
en: I'm grateful you looked the other way.
alternatives: I appreciate that you chose to overlook it.
Thank you for letting it slide.
point: look the other way はあえて見逃すこと。

ja: 調整してくれてありがとう。
en: Thanks for ironing things out.
alternatives: Thanks for sorting things out.
Thank you for resolving things.
point: iron out は問題や行き違いを解決する。

ja: 君が重大さを察してくれて私は感謝する。
en: I'm grateful you knew what was at stake.
alternatives: I'm grateful you grasped what was at stake.
Thank you for understanding what was at stake.
point: at stake は結果次第で失われかねないものを表す。

ja: 私が弁償するよ。
en: I'll pay for it.
alternatives: I'll cover the cost.
I'm going to reimburse you.
I'll pay for the damage.
point: pay for で壊したものなどの代金を負担する。

ja: ちょっと出しゃばりすぎたかも。
en: I may have overstepped a little.
alternatives: I might have overstepped a bit.
I think I overstepped a little.
point: may have + 過去分詞で断定を避ける

ja: 昨日は本当に助かったよ。
en: You really helped me yesterday.
alternatives: Thanks for helping me yesterday.
You were a big help yesterday.
point: help の過去形は helped

ja: 私が埋め合わせすべきです。
en: I should make amends.
alternatives: I ought to make amends.
I should make things right.
point: make amends は過ちの埋め合わせをする。

ja: 彼女は一生恩に着ると言った。
en: She said she'd be forever in my debt.
alternatives: She told me she'd be forever in my debt.
She said she owed me big time.
point: 恩に着るは in one's debt。時制は said に合わせる

ja: 私への控えめな配慮に感謝します。
en: I appreciate your discreet thoughtfulness.
alternatives: I'm grateful for your discreet care.
Thank you for your unobtrusive thoughtfulness.
point: discreet thoughtfulness は控えめな配慮。thoughtfulness は数えない。

ja: 君のような優しさは忘れないよ。
en: I'll never forget kindness like yours.
alternatives: I won't forget kindness like yours.
Kindness like yours won't be forgotten.
point: like yours が kindness を後ろから修飾する

ja: 新人なので、助かります。
en: Being new, I appreciate the help.
alternatives: As a newcomer, I appreciate your help.
Since I'm new, your help means a lot.
point: Being ~ は「~なので」の分詞構文

ja: 寝坊して、遅れてすみません。
en: Sorry I'm late, having overslept.
alternatives: Sorry for being late, having overslept.
I'm sorry to be late, having overslept.
Sorry I'm late because I overslept.
point: 先に起きたことは having + 過去分詞

ja: 救われたのは、君の辛抱強さだよ。
en: It was your patience that saved me.
alternatives: Your patience is what saved me.
What saved me was your patience.
point: It was ~ that で感謝の中心を強調

ja: 許してくれる？
en: Can you forgive me?
alternatives: Will you forgive me?
Could you forgive me?
point: 許しを頼むときは Can you で始める

ja: 誘ってくれてありがとう。
en: Thanks for asking me to join.
alternatives: Thanks for inviting me along.
Thank you for inviting me.
point: ask 人 to do で参加するよう誘う。

ja: そこまで大変とは知らなかった。
en: I hadn't realized it was that tough.
alternatives: I didn't know it was that hard.
I had no idea it was that hard.
I hadn't realized how hard it was.
point: 知った時より前のことは過去完了
